sameValueReason.repair: Object.is compares the thrown value with the actual retained cancellation reason; NaN is recognized and re-thrown rather than converted into WasmEncodeError.
sameValueReason.adjacentReasonSelection: Only undefined receives the default AbortError; defined null and other legal unknown reason values are retained unchanged.
sameValueReason.providerFailure: Actual provider exceptions still exit their call before any post-call cancellation check; native codec errors still follow original metadata/cause handling unless they are the exact original cancellation value.

boundedCanvasTransitions: Capability function returns before its post-return cancellation check
Canvas is adopted before checking after createElement and before setting dimensions
Width and height setters are followed by checks before the next platform action
Actual 2d context is adopted after getContext before cancellation/clearRect
Actual clearRect is captured/bound before admission; return is checked before fill/draw
fillStyle setter return is checked before reading the actual fillRect method
Actual fillRect is captured/bound before admission; return is checked before draw
Bitmap/image argument and actual five-argument drawImage method are captured before admission
drawImage return is checked before bitmap release; release return is checked before subsequent work
Actual returned image-data resource is adopted before checking after getImageData
Actual constructed encoded Blob is adopted before checking after construction
Fallback toBlob is still awaited to its actual callback before adoption/check
Actual constructed output File is adopted before post-constructor cancellation
asyncCompletion: No post-start check replaces the actual pending FileReader event, bitmap/codec Promise, toBlob callback, arrayBuffer Promise or digest Promise. Started work still retains original handles and awaits actual completion/failure.
census: Encoded WASM Blob is registered at construction; the common path registers only the actual fallback Blob, avoiding duplicate custody entries. Output File has a temporary local reference entry; successful result still returns that same actual File and transfers caller custody without claiming heap reclamation.
